FirstLight Home Care Launches Cross-Country RV Tour Following Growth Milestone

30 Oct 2026, 10:26 PM IST · GlobeWire Daily Business Desk · Source: www.prnewswire.com

Image: FirstLight Home Care — Creative Commons

Key takeaways Cross-Country Journey Marks Network Expansion FirstLight Home Care has announced the launch of its "Best Days Tour," a cross-country RV trip led by President and CEO Glee McAnanly. The journey marks the company's recent milestone of surpassing 300 operating locations

Cross-Country Journey Marks Network Expansion

FirstLight Home Care has announced the launch of its "Best Days Tour," a cross-country RV trip led by President and CEO Glee McAnanly. The journey marks the company's recent milestone of surpassing 300 operating locations across the United States. Rather than hosting an internal corporate celebration, executive leadership opted to travel directly to local franchise communities to meet with owners, care teams, and clients.

The tour officially began on Monday, Oct. 26, with an opening event at the Portland Head Light in Cape Elizabeth, Maine. The initial leg of the trip focuses on East Coast locations throughout the fall, with further nationwide stops scheduled to continue through 2027.

Context and Industry Growth

The expansion of the home care network coincides with an increasing demand for domestic care services nationwide. According to company figures cited in the announcement, approximately 63 million Americans currently provide ongoing care for family members, reflecting an increase of nearly 20 million over the past decade. This rising demand has driven more households to seek professional in-home assistance for seniors, veterans, adults with disabilities, and individuals managing dementia or other health conditions.

In addition to its physical expansion, FirstLight Home Care received recognition from Entrepreneur magazine in 2026, securing placements among the publication's Top 100 Fastest-Growing Franchises and Top 10 Senior Care Franchises.

Practical Implications and Reader Verification

For families and community members interested in following the executive team's travel route, or those seeking local care resources, the organization is documenting the journey through digital and social media channels under the title of the "Care-A-Van" project.

Readers can verify all details regarding the corporate milestone, company background, and ongoing tour dates directly through the official [FirstLight Home Care website](https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/firstlight-home-care-hits-the-road-to-celebrate-300-locations-with-the-best-days-tour-302922457.html).
